text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the New Year holidays, since this 
was our make-or-break year, I went to 
Hatsumode with Dants Flame. On the way 
back...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh, looks like a crowd is gathering. 
'First Calligraphy of the Year Corner'...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Word is, those Umamusume gals are getting 
crazy hyped up about something.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Just from doing kakizome? What's going on? 
Let's go see.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: 'Uma Musume ladies'……?
"Revolution"—!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! Is that how your canvas 
paints the future?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“...To revitalize... the Japanese racing 
world— That is... my mission—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the center of the crowd was Symboli 
Kris S, an international student from 
America who made her debut last fall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And having debuted last year as well, 
Tanino Gimlet, who took some time off to 
rest but snatched a brilliant victory last 
month. And—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahaha! A revolution, is it? You certainly 
talk a big game.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was No Reason, an Umamusume whose debut 
was just around the corner, known for 
carrying herself like a Sengoku warlord.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Can one so easily dye something in their 
own colors when it is not even in their 
grasp yet, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed— Therefore, first... we 
establish it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This year... I will conquer the peak of 
our generation—the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The end of that dream is a nightmare— The 
"Japanese Derby" is the first step of my 
Genesis! The very first hoofprint 
engraving the brilliance of a "fleeting 
instant"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
*Snap!* The unfolded paper boldly displays 
the word "Instant." The crowd gasps once 
more at the dazzling performance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! In that case, this is my character! 
The sweet, delicious, beloved character: 
'Manju'!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Manju"... Man... jyu, huh... I see... 
Those are quite delicious—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Laughable...! Hiding your talons before 
my keen eye, are you, hawk?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She's just talking, but it feels like 
she's putting on a full-blown stage 
performance...! Wh-What incredible star 
quality...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I see, so those three will be clashing on 
this year's Classic circuit!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds interesting. I wasn't really into 
races, but maybe I'll go check one out~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... Everyone is from the 
generation below—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Which means, there might be someone I'll 
be racing against this year. ...Things 
really are changing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, actually, I heard something the other 
day—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Pokke-chan, you're thinking about an 
"overseas expedition"!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Right after the next Takarazuka 
Kinen! Traveling the world will give me 
some guts. It'll make me stronger.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Cafe's running the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe this fall too, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Is that so? It's gonna be lonely 
for a while, then...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, you'd better brace yourself for the 
Takarazuka Kinen! I'm gonna put on a real 
show to kick things off!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"At the Takarazuka Kinen, I absolutely... 
I absolutely, definitely won't lose!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Or so they say!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
New challenges are starting, and new 
rivals are showing up...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Since I wasn't really in the spotlight 
during the Classic Triple Crown, I was 
thinking I'd brace myself and tighten up 
for the Senior Year, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I really, truly have to give it my 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the goal remains the same, 
circumstances change every day. What 
Dantsu Flame needs most right now is—
choice_data_list:
Let's eat something delicious and get 
pumped up!

You're feeling pumped—wanna go for a 
little run?
Shall we go buy some new shoes?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good♪ Oh, right! There's something 
I've been craving to eat—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. A friend told me about it 
yesterday. They said they were handing out 
mochi here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Dants? Yoo-hoo, Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Happy New Year~! I couldn't resist 
coming over to eat some mochi!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy~! Ah, um, is that 
person—could they be your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, because Dants talks about you all 
the time. Plus, everyone says you're 
always hanging out together.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wait, really!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I was able to spend a 
peaceful time with Dantsu Flame.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm, today felt so very eventful!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! If you're okay with it, absolutely! To 
be honest... I was itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Working out really does clear your 
head after all—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, look, Trainer! They're flying 
kites! That looks fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where they pointed, sure enough, 
several children were running across the 
field, flying kites.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's so nice. I... haven't really gotten 
together with friends for New Year's very 
often before!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, no, I couldn't possibly make 
you tag along for that!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's already evening... and it's 
starting to get cold...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... well, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
H-How about next year...? For kite 
flying...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...! Ehehe! Thank you! It's a promise, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I was able to spend a 
peaceful time with Dantsu Flame.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm, today felt so very eventful!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, are you sure?! Mine was starting to 
fall apart, so this is a lifesaver!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we went to a sporting goods store, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, these shoes are great! The funky 
design is so Pokke-chan! And it looks like 
they have reinforced resin toecaps, too—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This ultra-lightweight pair over here 
looks great for Cafe-chan. The thick soles 
seem to offer plenty of cushioning too~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I should introduce them to those two next 
time.
choice_data_list: I came to check out your shoes~
I came to check out your shoes~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Sorry, I didn't mean to. Umm, shoes 
that might fit me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Amazing, these shoes fit Trainer's 
feet just—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, that's right! I-I'm so sorry~! 
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I was able to spend a 
peaceful time with Dantsu Flame.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm, today felt so very eventful!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, that really cheered me up. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"From tomorrow on as well... I look 
forward to working with you this year!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a brand-new year began.
